subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are writing to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on May 15th, 2022. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: AB1234 Departure: New York (JFK) at 10:00 AM Arrival: London (LHR) at 10:00 PM If you have any questions or need assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, The Airline Team
